boo.name: Boo & Co.
boo.hero_sub: Boo finds a door in the garden, a city under the bath water and a sky on her bedroom ceiling. Pick a world and go there together.
boo.promise: Bedtime stories, colouring worlds and personalised books starring a small girl called Boo — and, if you like, your child beside her.
boo.about:
We are parents first.

We are storytellers by trade — and long before any of this was a shop, it was a bedtime. The stories we could buy were fine. They were just never quite the ones we wanted to read to our own children.

We wanted three things for them, and could not reliably find them on a shelf: imagination, the ability to invent something that isn't in the room. Curiosity, the instinct to look behind the sofa. And kindness — the part no worksheet teaches, the part that turns into how a child treats people for the rest of their life.

So we started drawing. Every story here is one we have read out loud in our own house first. If it does not work on our children — if they wriggle, or ask for a different one — it does not go on this site.

That is the whole promise. Made by parents, tested by the hardest audience there is.

hive.name: Happy Hive
hive.hero_sub: Rico is one year old and he is investigating. Behind the sofa, under the flowerpot, inside the cardboard box that is definitely a rocket. Come and see what he finds.
hive.promise: Books, colouring worlds and adventure kits for small people who want to know what is behind everything.

products.name: Boo and the Garden That Woke Up
products.value: A first story about cause and effect
products.hook: She waters one flower. The whole garden gets up.
products.pitch: Boo is handed a watering can and takes the job extremely seriously. One flower yawns, then stretches, then keeps stretching until it is taller than the gate. A story about doing one small thing and watching what it sets off.
products.child_gets: The idea that a small action can change everything around it — plus a ladybird that lands on your nose.
inside: A dedication page you can fill in
Print-at-home PDF and a tablet version
products.how: Pay, download, read. The link appears on screen straight away and lands in your inbox too.
products.trust: Instant download · Refund if it will not open

products.name: Boo and the Night the Stars Came Down
products.value: A wind-down book, built to end the day
products.hook: A star gets tired of being far away.
products.pitch: Written to be read slowly. The sentences get shorter as the book goes on, the pictures get darker and warmer, and the last spread has almost no words at all. It is designed to land a child somewhere near sleep.
products.child_gets: A calm ending to the day, and a star of their own to hold on the last page.
inside: 10 spreads that get quieter as they go
A two-line goodnight to say together
products.how: Download once, keep forever. Read it on a tablet with the brightness low, or print it.
products.trust: Instant download · Made for the last 10 minutes of the day

products.name: Under the Bath, an Ocean
products.value: A braver, busier story for a slightly older child
products.hook: The plug comes out. Boo does not.
products.pitch: The noisiest book we make. Boo puts on a glass helmet and goes down, and there is a whole lit city under there with jellyfish for streetlamps. More happens per page than in the other two.
products.child_gets: A big loud adventure, and the idea that the ordinary thing in front of you might have a whole world under it.
inside: 10 busy spreads full of things to find
products.how: Pay, download, read. Best read with a child who likes pointing at things.

products.value: Join the dots and Boo appears
products.hook: Every page hides her somewhere new.
